review: Independently reviewed the model card, versioned REST reference and Vertex standard global pricing table. GenerateContent and structured output are documented; listed model locations are global, us and eu. The regional host allowlist does not establish exact-model availability in us-central1. Standard global text input is 0.25 USD per million tokens and text output including reasoning is 1.50 USD per million tokens. Developer API pricing, priority, Flex/Batch, cached input, promotional credits and free usage are not used.
limitations: Public documentation and offline SDK serialization establish no account eligibility, key type, project association, IAM permission, billing cap or successful API access. Re-review prices and documentation before any future billable authorization.
